clockProbeSemantics.compactRaw: Initial reading, at most16 positive advances with readOrdinal/value, totalReads/equal-run counts, any abort reading/ordinal and resource flags; equal readings losslessly reconstructible without262144 duplicate JSON values.
clockProbeSemantics.positiveAdvances: Consecutive performance.now values increasing; equal reads do not count, negative/nonfinite abort. After a read,16 positives may complete when elapsed<=20 and reads<=262144 and every other probe rule passes, including equality at caps. Any exceeded cap fails; at a cap with fewer than16 positives fail without another read.
clockProbeSemantics.observedStepNotPrecision: Polling/scheduling/coarsening all affect steps. <=0.25ms cannot certify timer accuracy.
clockProbeSemantics.deadline: performance.now elapsed checked every read; Date.now resource guard each256 reads and on completion, backward wall jump aborts. Wall epoch not exported. One API call cannot be preempted:20ms is not hard realtime CPU guarantee.
clockProbeSemantics.zeroWork: Raw0 kept/censored, reserve0.25ms against work budget. Do not call actual cost0 or upper bound0.25. Unknown probe blocks.

retryIdle.preExposure: At most2 explicit preparations for one host-admitted frozen attempt across client aliases; no reservation/draw before ready. New host-admitted attempt may start anew; a client-renamed string cannot.
retryIdle.postExposure: Any failure after reservation/draw ends same attempt, including practice. Only read-only/original save retries; no switch/replacement exposure.
retryIdle.idle: Every existing1000ms fixation starts new segment; Any idle duration gets the same revalidation; no stale-time threshold exists. Need>=60 intervals at first-formal-draw gate, no extension/new fixation or extra preflight after exposure.

oncePerPrep: preparationStartPerfMs before probe; initial resource wall guard (epoch not exported)
rawClockContract.absence: unknown; do not fill from planned deadline or neutral clear
rawClockContract.storage: Bounded client memory, preparation/trial boundary write; full archive with core references, no per-frame server calls.

exposureDefinition.trialExposureReserved: A task-trial exposure reservation, including practice; counts even if first draw has not yet happened.
exposureDefinition.retryWithinClaim: If only preflight failed and no task trial was reserved/drawn, one explicit retry within the same legitimate claim is allowed, up to2 total; no new fresh claim fabricated.

hostAdmissionIdentity.required: Platform-authorized and frozen administration identity, potentially verified sessionId+attemptNo ->candidate attemptId mapping
hostAdmissionIdentity.newLegitimateHostAttempt: May reset its own two-preparation budget; not poisoned by an older completed attempt on the same page
hostAdmissionIdentity.sameAttempt: Context/port/client-string rename does not reset budget or ended/exposed marker; new realm ends it
